question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Marvellous
solution:
The correct solution is **"Terrible"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marvellous** refers to something that is **very good**.

 
 
• ***Example:** Ayan has done a **marvellous** job*
 
 
 
• The opposing word to **Marvellous** should serve as the **antonym**.
 
• **Terrible** denotes which is extremely bad.
 
 
• ***Example:** The service of the restaurant is **terrible**.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the opposite word of marvellous is terrible.​​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adverse** refers to impeding achievement or growth.

 
 
• ***Example:** The match was canceled because of **adverse **weather.*
 
 
 
• **Tolerable** refers to something that can be tolerated or borne.
 
 
• ***Example:** The heast was not **tolerable .***
 
 
 
• **Mythical** refers to something that only exists in the mind.
 
 
• ***Example:** Raavan was a **mythical **hero.*
